scope_note: CORRECTED 2026-09-11. An earlier version of this ledger asserted NE@SEA was never forecast. It was: a V1_CANDIDATE forecast was sealed at a T-31h information set and scored against the realised game. BOTH games are genuine prospective case studies, n=2, with different limitations rather than one being unusable.
promotion_rule: No modeling item may be promoted on this evidence. Every MODELING defect below requires multi-game prospective evidence and a pre-registration before any change is scored as an improvement.

defects.symptom: THE PROSPECTIVE LEDGER COULD NOT SEE A SEALED FORECAST THAT EXISTS. nfl/research/shadow/g1_ne_sea/ holds a V1_CANDIDATE forecast sealed before the outcome was opened (bba6f0b) and scored against the realised game (604eaac). Both were committed and both were in the working tree. research.daily_board.discover hard-codes one root (nfl/research/live/) and one label grammar ({pre,post}_inactives_V1_CANDIDATE[_R<n>]); the shadow artifact matched neither, so a review reported its absence as the fact "NE@SEA was NEVER FORECAST". A second seal, g1_ne_sea_runB, was also invisible.

defects.symptom: A SINGLE DRAW PUTS 16 COMPLETIONS ON 30 ATTEMPTS AND NETS MINUS 32 PASSING YARDS. Board d1e2727743c93990, Bo Nix (00-0039732), draw 885: att=30, cmp=16, pyds=-32.0. Negative passing yardage is legitimate in this engine and is deliberately not clipped -- test_draw_coherence asserts that no non-negativity check is declared over any yardage array, and that is correct. What is NOT legitimate is this magnitude at this completion count: sixteen completed passes averaging about -2 yards each is not a football outcome, and no realised NFL game resembles it. The cell is therefore a pathological tail of the yards-per-completion draw, not an instance of the ordinary short-loss completion the non-clipping policy exists to preserve.
defects.earliest_layer: qb passing yardage draw (yards per completion), downstream of the C3 shared passing event
defects.root_cause_classification: UNDIAGNOSED -- found by a fence, not yet traced to a line
defects.blast_radius: 1 cell in 1,000 draws on ONE board. Measured across all 104 sealed boards in nfl/research/live/: qb/pyds carries 2,262 negative cells in total, of which 2,261 sit on QB-only boards (no receiving layer) and exactly ONE sits on a board carrying the shared passing event. That one is this cell. Tonight's FINAL board 96954efc523bd7d3 carries NONE and is clean. The invariant that previously held -- every negative passing-yard cell lives on a run WITHOUT the shared passing event -- is now false, by one cell.
defects.impact: Negligible for a mean or a median and material for any tail statistic, which is exactly the class of statistic this project intends to report: CRPS, log score, PIT and tail calibration all read the region this cell sits in. It must not be absorbed into a count fence as though it were ordinary negative yardage.
defects.test_required: test_draw_coherence::test_negative_yardage_is_left_alone_and_the_reason_is_measured now pins c3-side negatives at 1 and names this defect. The fix is NOT to clip: it is to find why yards-per-completion can go this far negative at 16 completions, and the check must go back to 0 by construction, never by widening the fence.

defects.symptom: THREE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-FOUR CONSECUTIVE official_inactives CAPTURES REPORTED PASS/CAPTURED OVER A PAGE THAT CARRIES NO INACTIVE PLAYERS AT ALL, AND EIGHT OF THEM WERE DECLARED ELIGIBLE TO DISCHARGE THE DEN@KC INACTIVES OBLIGATION WITH ZERO REFUSALS. https://www.nfl.com/inactives/ served, for the whole of Week 1 2026, an empty-state page whose own body text reads verbatim 'Please check back soon for NFL Inactive Reports for this Season'. It contains zero <table> and zero <tr> elements. Every capture of it from 2026-09-07T00:24:48Z through 2026-09-15T13:06:38Z -- 374 distinct blobs, nine days, including twenty-nine sweeps taken AFTER the DEN@KC kickoff and thirteen hours after the game ended -- stored that empty page and recorded state PASS, code CAPTURED, with a non-zero n_data_rows.
defects.earliest_layer: nfl/capture/registry.py:234 content_markers for official_inactives, consumed at nfl/tools/capture_vintage.py:325-358
defects.repaired_by: SourceSpec.row_container (nfl/capture/registry.py:136, declared on both html sources at :228 and :251), consumed by the html substance branch of nfl/tools/capture_vintage.py and by nfl/capture/coverage.py::_has_declared_rows. Replayed by nfl/tests/test_inactives_substance.py -- 16 checks, 0 failures, 0 NOT_EXECUTED.
defects.root_cause_classification: DIAGNOSED TO A LINE. capture_vintage.py has a correct and deliberate substance guard: at :345 a zero-marker HTML payload returns Outcome.deferred('SOURCE_HAS_NO_ROWS_YET'), explicitly so that an unpublished page is recorded as a debt rather than a capture. The guard never fires here because the marker vocabulary for this source is the single word 'inactive' (registry.py:234, content_markers=('inactive',)), and that word appears 41 times in the page's OWN CHROME. Full decomposition of all 41 occurrences on blob official_inactives.73f408bbbf15491e.html.gz: 2 in <title>, 1 in meta[name=description], 1 in og:url, 1 in link[rel=canonical], 4 in the ad and analytics config objects (advPageInfo, trackingPageInfo), 2 in the visually-hidden <h1>, 2 in the placeholder promo's alt text and headline, 1 in the empty-state sentence itself, and 27 in data-link_name / data-link_url / href / title / aria-label / <h3> / summary attributes of news tiles. ZERO are player rows. The single most direct statement of the defect: the page's own declaration that it has no data -- 'Please check back soon for NFL Inactive Reports for this Season' -- is counted as one unit of evidence that it has data. n_data_rows is then set to the marker count (capture_vintage.py:358), so the chrome count is laundered into a row count and every downstream consumer sees 41 rows.
defects.blast_radius: MEASURED, not estimated. Of 392 official_inactives records in state PASS carrying a blob: 374 are the empty landing page, 18 are delivered markdown intelligence captures on a different code path (see below), 0 carry an html table. The 374 report n_data_rows of 4 (x84), 23 (x1), 30 (x162), 34 (x22) and 41 (x105) -- the count tracks how many news tiles the landing page happened to be showing, which is why it drifts. Eight of the 374 additionally passed discharge_eligibility for target 2026_01_DEN_KC kind 'inactives' with refusals == [] (capture_ids 20260914T225240Z, 230328Z, 231657Z, 232654Z, 233515Z, 234455Z, 235244Z, 235935Z). Those 8 are PROVENANCE-LAWFUL: execution_target.declared_before_fetch is true, basis is SCHEDULED_WINDOW_ANCHORED, and each retrieved_at falls inside the declared window 2026-09-14T22:45:00Z..2026-09-15T00:05:00Z, executed by the GitHub Actions workflow 'NFL T-90 anchored capture' on refs/heads/main. The provenance chain is sound and the content is empty, which is exactly why this defect is dangerous: nothing in the provenance layer is wrong. Not yet measured: whether any other html source's content_markers are similarly satisfiable by chrome. The json and csv sources take different content_kind branches and are not implicated by this evidence.
defects.consequence: The DEN@KC board d1e2727743c93990 was sealed with no official_inactive_ids. That is unchanged and correct -- this branch never held these captures. What changes is the DIAGNOSIS: the obligation did not go unattempted. It was attempted 8 times inside the window by a scheduled executor and each attempt returned a page with nothing on it. Had this branch consumed those captures, the R2 eligibility gate would have been handed 41 'rows' of navigation furniture and would have reported the inactives obligation DISCHARGED over an empty set. The capture network working and the capture network yielding data are different facts.
defects.where_the_data_actually_was: The empty page links to it, and the project already proved the link works. Occurrences 17-22 of the marker word are the href and title of /news/week-1-monday-night-inactives-denver-broncos-at-kansas-city-chiefs with summary text 'Here are the official inactives for the Denver Broncos at the Kansas City Chiefs'. THE CONTRAST THAT SETTLES IT: the 18 delivered markdown captures include 20260910T234420Z, 'SF @ LA: Final Pregame Intelligence Capture', which carries BOTH complete official inactive lists and cites https://www.nfl.com/news/australia-game-inactives-san-francisco-49ers-at-los-angeles-rams -- the per-game news article, retrieved by the networked agent. So the data existed, was published on time, and was reachable; the registry's url_template points at a landing page that no longer carries the table. This is a wrong-endpoint defect wearing a substance-guard defect as a mask. Registering the correct per-game endpoint pattern needs network and is OUT-016.
defects.predeclared_repair_bar: A repair is accepted only if, replayed against the committed blob official_inactives.73f408bbbf15491e.html.gz, the capture returns a non-PASS outcome, AND replayed against a blob that does carry real inactive rows it still returns PASS. The second half is mandatory: tightening markers until the empty page fails is trivial and would also reject real data. No positive-control blob exists for the HTML branch in this repository -- all 392 PASS records are either the empty landing page or delivered markdown on a different code path -- which is why this defect is recorded rather than repaired, and why the test committed alongside it asserts the DEFECT and reports its positive control as NOT_EXECUTED rather than skipping it silently.
defects.found_by: TASK ZERO reconciliation with main, 2026-09-15. Found by decompressing the blobs, not by any test, and not by reading the manifest rows that describe them -- the manifest rows all say PASS. THREE successive claims about this window were wrong before the bytes were opened: (1) 'the window closed unfilled with zero attempts' -- false, 8 lawful attempts were made; (2) 'main carries in-window PASS captures, so the window was filled' -- false, they are empty, and this one was written into commit 2c0c36b; (3) 'the blast radius is 37 captures in the 09-14/15 window' -- false, it is 374 captures over nine days, corrected here after section C of the replay test counted them. Each correction came from looking at one layer deeper than the previous claim had.
defects.replayed_by: nfl/tests/test_inactives_substance.py (sections B and C FAIL by design; section D reports NOT_EXECUTED)
defects.repair_shape: THE MARKER VOCABULARY IS UNCHANGED, deliberately. Tuning words until the empty page fails is the move that caused the defect in the first place -- a previous pass had this source passing on four incidental 'questionable's, and when those four left the page it flipped to FAIL over 419KB of real content. Instead each html source now declares the SHAPE its rows live in (row_container=('<tr',)), and a payload carrying the subject word but not one row container is DEFERRED as SOURCE_HAS_NO_ROWS_YET -- the outcome capture_vintage.py:345 already had for exactly this case and could never reach. Deferred, not failed: an unpublished source is a debt, not an error. This is a declared property of the source, not a threshold fitted to data.
defects.two_sided_proof: The positive control I first reported as missing DOES exist, and claiming otherwise was the fourth wrong statement in this defect's history. It is not a populated inactives page -- there is none -- but official_injury_report, which is content_kind html and runs the identical code path. Replayed over every committed blob: official_injury_report 374 of 374 PASS (<tr> present in all 374, 13 to 214 rows); official_inactives 392 of 392 DEFERRED SOURCE_HAS_NO_ROWS_YET (<tr> present in 0). Complete separation, no threshold. Section E of the replay test strips row_container from the spec and shows the same empty bytes pass again, so the guard is demonstrated load-bearing per the binding test standard rather than merely passing on compliant data.
defects.downstream_blast_radius_at_the_coverage_: MEASURED, and it is larger than the capture layer. nfl/capture/coverage.py::performed_from_manifest credited any row whose state was PASS and whose blob hashed correctly. Neither test reads what the bytes say, and a hash over an empty page is a perfect hash. Week 1 2026, 63 targets: crediting the empty captures gives covered 43 / missed 20. Refusing them gives covered 28 / missed 35, of which 13 are misses holding uncredited game-anchored bytes and 22 have nothing at all. FIFTEEN targets -- 24% of the week -- were reported covered on the strength of a page saying 'Please check back soon'. The same declared row_container now gates the reader, scoped to content_kind 'html'; exactly 374 rows are excluded, each recorded individually in artifact_excluded with reason SOURCE_HAS_NO_ROWS_YET and its capture_id, so the exclusion is auditable rather than silent. DEN@KC inactives remains a miss and is now named as such for the right reason.
defects.history_not_rewritten: No manifest row was altered, deleted or re-stated. All 374 stay state PASS with their original n_data_rows. Capture evidence is append-only. What changed is what a READER credits them with discharging, and the honest answer was always none. d1e2727743c93990 is untouched and the Week-1 miss remains a miss.
defects.still_open: The endpoint itself. https://www.nfl.com/inactives/ is still what the registry points at, and it is still empty -- the repair makes the system TELL THE TRUTH about that rather than fix it. Week 1's inactives are genuinely unrecoverable. OUT-016 asks the networked agent for the per-game article pattern and whether its slug is derivable pregame or only discoverable, which imply different capture designs.
defects.repair_near_miss: RECORDED BECAUSE IT ALMOST INVERTED THE DEFECT. The first cut of coverage._has_declared_rows applied the row_container test to every official_inactives row regardless of payload shape. Under this source name the store holds TWO shapes: 374 html landing pages (content_kind 'html') and 18 DELIVERED markdown captures (content_kind null, spec_version 'official-inactives-1') written by the networked agent -- and those 18 carry the only genuine inactive lists anywhere in the repository, including both complete lists for SF@LA. Markdown has no <tr>, so the first cut refused them: a repair aimed at evidence quality was deleting the evidence, and it presented as a cleaner number (missed_with_uncredited_evidence fell from 13 to 0). Caught by test_capture_obligations section E, which asserts the count 18 rather than a direction. Fixed by scoping the check to content_kind == 'html', since a row container is a claim about HTML and about nothing else. Now protected by section G of test_inactives_substance.py. The lesson is not about html: a repair is a step that returns something, and a step whose output looks better is exactly what this project's canonical defect class feels like from the inside.

defects.symptom: FIVE SITES PUBLISHED A RECONCILIATION STATISTIC THAT RESTATES NUMPY'S DOCUMENTATION, ONE OF THEM AS A BOOLEAN NAMED `exact` AND ONE OF THEM AS A HARD REFUSAL THAT CAN NEVER FIRE. Every site computes some form of abs(multinomial(n, p).sum() - n). numpy.random.multinomial(n, p) sums to n by contract, so the quantity is identically zero and says nothing about the allocator. Published as exactly 0.0 on 385,446 rows: 276,968 in Q6_DIAGNOSTICS.csv.gz, 104,130 in Q9B_FAMILY_ROWS.csv.gz, 4,348 in Q9_DIAGNOSTICS.csv.
defects.earliest_layer: the research reporting layer, five independent transcriptions of one wrong idea
defects.root_cause_classification: DIAGNOSED. The statistic asks whether the dealt units sum to the budget they were dealt from, which is guaranteed by the sampler's own definition. It is the same shape q7/panel.py already wrote down: compose db = att + sacks + scr, then assert att + sacks + scr == db, and learn only that addition works -- least of all that one of the three terms is structurally zero.
defects.proof_it_is_inert: Measured on seeded violations in test_p6_false_greens.py P6-FG-2, and those assertions are now INVERTED to preserve the demonstration: handing one player every single unit scores 0.0; deleting a player and giving his mass to his neighbour scores 0.0. It cannot see ANY error that preserves the total, which is every allocation error there is. The one thing it does catch is an allocation built against a different budget than it is scored against, so it is not inert in every direction -- and that bound is asserted too, rather than the claim being overstated.

site_census.note: The worst shape a false green takes: not a number nobody reads, but a boolean asserting the thing is right. Key removed, not renamed.

An inert GUARD, not an inert diagnostic, and materially worse: it has refused nothing on every input it has ever been given, which is precisely the assert_batch_games_are_new pattern nfl/tests/bypass.py was written about. It is DEFERRED because q9shadow is sealed prospective code and changing what it refuses is closure-changing: under the standing ruling that needs a NEW candidate identity, not an edit. Deferring it is a decision, not an oversight, and it must not be summarised as repaired.

defects.what_the_replacement_does_not_do: STATED SO IT IS NOT OVERSOLD. It scores the deal against the intent it was HANDED: if the shares themselves are wrong, dealt will match intended and it reads clean. Reconciliation is not validation, and P6-FG-2 asserts exactly that with a wrong-intent-faithfully-dealt case scoring 0.0. It is a mean over draws, so a correct mean with a wrong spread passes. A player whose share leaves no room for sampling noise reports inf rather than 0.
defects.no_fitted_constant: The standard error is the multinomial's own, derived rather than chosen, so the statistic is a z-score whose null behaviour is computable and is reported alongside it. Measured over 300 seeds at 5 players, budget 30, 64 draws: a correct allocation gives median 1.43, p95 2.57, max 3.71; the seeded violations give 87.6 and 21.9. Nothing gates on it -- it reports.
defects.republication_debt: OPEN AND UNCHANGED, and now known to be larger than it looked. The producers still emit the inert column because they are sealed and were reverted, so Q6_DIAGNOSTICS.csv.gz, Q9B_FAMILY_ROWS.csv.gz and Q9_DIAGNOSTICS.csv all still carry 385,446 rows of zero and every consumer still reads them. Three checks in P6-FG-2 fail on exactly this and are kept failing: deleting them would hide it. defects.absent_and_empty_are_different_states: SCHEMA_COLUMNS_ABSENT is a FAIL, not a DEFERRED. A column the source no longer sends is a wrong document -- a schema change, a redirect, an error page rendered as csv -- and waiting for it to fill in is the wrong response. A column present and unpopulated, or an availability column that says nothing yet, is a source that has not published: that is a debt and defers. Collapsing the two would repeat D20's error one level up, treating 'we got the wrong thing' as 'not yet'.

Requiring report_status outright would have flipped two legitimate captures to DEFERRED; quietly dropping it because it failed would be fitting the guard to the data. THE ONE-LINE STATEMENT: A written_at CUTOFF DOES NOT PIN AN INPUT SET WHEN THE MANIFEST IS APPEND-ONLY AND CAN GAIN ROWS DATED BEFORE THAT CUTOFF. defects.why_it_outranks_most_open_items: Every chronological comparison in this project re-runs a historical window. If each re-run silently re-selects its inputs as the corpus grows, two arms compared on 'the same' 2024 game may not have seen the same 2024 game, and no before-and-after is reproducible. That is the evidentiary basis of V2. It also means a candidate identity recomputed today need not match the one sealed with it, without anything having gone wrong.
defects.the_fix_is_already_in_the_artifact: Every seal records consumed_partition_ids. A REPLAY must reproduce FROM those recorded ids; only a NEW FORECAST re-runs selection. Re-running selection and calling the result a replay produces a different forecast wearing the same clock, which is precisely what the fingerprint discipline exists to prevent. The structural proof that this is not possible today: inputs.bundle's signature is (kickoff_utc, written_at, sources=None) -- no parameter accepts a recorded input set, so no caller can pin a rebuild.
